episodes.title: Bethany Joy Lenz on Escaping a Cult, One Tree Hill Secrets & Her Letter to Nicholas Sparks
episodes.description:
This week on Haley on the Go Bethany Joy Lenz, who you may know as Haley James Scott on One Tree Hill, opens up about the decade she spent inside a cult, what it took to get out, and how she’s learned to find the places where she truly belongs.
We also talk about what life on the One Tree Hill set was really like while it was all happening, the letter she wrote to Nicholas Sparks, rebuilding identity, faith, and community after leaving and more.


It's  a conversation you don't want to miss!


Haley on the Go is the show where I take you inside the conversations everyone should be having. We are talking to the people you care most about about the issues that matter most to you.
